name: Kawasaki Ninja ZX-4R / ZX-4RR
engine: 399 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: A small four that revs past 15,000 rpm. Some early bikes have spark plug and alternator recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2023-2024 bikes are in recall 24V221 (spark plugs), and some 2023 ZX-4RR KRT Editions in 23V515 (alternator rotor bolt).
A-002.reason: Both can stall the engine. The fixes are free.

recalls.what: Spark plugs may have been damaged in assembly, causing rough idle, hesitation or stalling.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the spark plugs free.

recalls.what: Alternator rotor bolt may not be tight, which can cause an engine stall.
recalls.fix: Dealer checks the bolt and tightens it free.
